syllabus_topics: Stationary electric current. Current density and intensity. Charge continuity equation. Ohm's Law. Joule's Law. Kirchhoff's Laws.
Magnetic Field in vacuum. Biot-Savart Law. Ampère's Law. Lorentz Force. Coils.
Electric and Magnetic Fields in the presence of matter. Polarization and Magnetization. Diamagnetism, paramagnetism and ferromagnetism.
Electromagnetic induction. Faraday's Law. Electric motors and generators. Magnetic energy. Displacement current.
Maxwell's laws. Electromagnetic nature of light. Dispersion, polarization, reflection, refraction. Fresnel's Laws.
assessment_rules: The final grade is the maximum of four combinations of the MAP45 exams (including resits), weekly problem series, and the monitored study program. The MAP45 component has a minimum grade of 6 values. The weekly problem series can contribute 20% if they improve the grade, considering the best 6 out of 7. The monitored study program can contribute 10% (2 values) if it improves the grade and if the grade from other components is not >=15 values. For working students, evaluation is identical or a single 100% exam. For special or extraordinary periods, a single 100% exam on all material is given. Cheating leads to the annulment of all involved tests.
